## Theming: What's the point?

Captain a small spaceship and explore as much of the galaxy as possible: recruit crew, visit planets, fight enemy ships, and brave asteroid fields.

### Shared or solo play

The creator campaign presents the game as a print-and-play roll-and-write for one or more players. Each captain records an individual voyage.

## Setting up: How to get started?

Each player needs a Game Sheet and Space Map. The game is print-and-play and supports solo play or any number of players. Check the supplied PnP files for exact starting marks and dice.

### Match components first

Use sheets and dice from the same PnP version. The public campaign does not establish whether later files changed icons, starting positions, or player aids.

## Rounds and Phases

Play 18 rounds, each called a **Star Calendar Day**. Resolve each day's roll-and-write choices on the Game Sheet and Space Map. A final public official rulebook was not located, so use the supplied files for the exact dice results and action sequence.

### Day order

The campaign confirms the round count, not the complete step order. Read the supplied PnP rules before the first day and follow their sequence consistently for all 18 days.

### Multiplayer etiquette

If players share dice or a result, ensure every player records the same public result before anyone moves to the next step. The exact shared-roll procedure must come from the supplied files.

## Scoring

After the eighteenth Star Calendar Day, total the scoring categories on the Game Sheet. Verify category values and tie handling in the supplied PnP rules.

### No inferred objectives

Crew, planets, enemies, and asteroids are confirmed exploration elements, but this public source does not state their individual point values.

## Terminology

**Star Calendar Day**: one of the game's 18 rounds. **Space Map**: the sheet used to record exploration. **Crew**, **planets**, **enemy ships**, and **asteroid fields**: major exploration elements.

### Game Sheet

The Game Sheet is the companion record for your captain's progress and final scoring categories.

## Official rules

The [creator Kickstarter campaign](https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/tristam-rossin/uncharted-stars) verifies the game's format and 18-round structure. No final official public rulebook was located; use the PnP files supplied with the game for procedural and scoring details.

### Limitation

This page gives a verified overview only. It deliberately does not reconstruct the day procedure, icon effects, combat, or scoring values from unofficial copies.
